column7: 2026-11-06: parseJsonParameter(query, key) helper for reports ?filter=<JSON> was added then removed at the user's request (not shipped). Reason: account IDs are 64-bit, and plain JSON.parse silently rounds them (1274593846275813376 -> 1274593846275813400). Also parse() needs the query only, so a full link needs extract() first. Options noted: have the producer write IDs as strings (my recommendation), or parse unsafe integers losslessly. User is deciding; do not re-add the helper until they choose.

2026-11-06: Added parse() types 'json' (plain JSON.parse; invalid JSON stays string; null stays null). Tests in test/parse.js, readme and base.d.ts documented. Still open: 64-bit integers are rounded by JSON.parse (same reason parseJsonParameter was removed); user is choosing between producer writing IDs as strings (my recommendation) or lossless unsafe-integer parsing. Do not change 'json' to lossless or re-add the helper until they choose.
